text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's make that zoo our 
destination for the next day off. As 
usual, we can meet in front of the Ritto 
Dormitory and head to the station—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong, Meek? If you have any 
other requests, please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Ughhhh, I'm sorry, Meek! I think we 
really should take the train this time...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
My driving skills are far from ready... 
Just imagining it for a moment makes me 
worry, "What if something happened to 
you...?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Meek... I wasn't able to live 
up to your expectations—

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...She said it straight. ...For my sake. 
...So cool."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek—thank you. I'll do my best... so that 
I can look cool when driving too.
